meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会获得一个真实的 Dial 电话号码,能收发短信、应答 AI 语音来电。安装会复制 Dial 适配器、注册线路,并让你用短信把手机和这条线路配对。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 添加 Dial 渠道、要一个能收发短信和接电话的号码时触发。设置会依次复制适配器、登记配对步骤、重启服务并注册线路。

say.text: 给这个安装加上 Dial 渠道,我要一个能收发短信和接电话的号码
say.note: 会复制适配器并开始配置 Dial 线路

say.text: 这条 Dial 线路用 owner 模式,只允许我配对的手机号找它
say.note: 其他人发消息会被拒绝

say.text: 把我收到的 6 位配对码发给 Dial 线路,完成配对
say.note: 适配器识别该码后绑定你的手机

howto.what_en: This skill gives Claude a real Dial phone number so it can send/receive SMS and answer AI voice calls. Setup copies the Dial adapter, registers the line, and pairs your phone via a texted code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Dial channel or a phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Setup then copies the adapter, registers the pairing step, restarts the service, and registers the line.

say_en.text: Add the Dial channel — I want a number that texts and takes calls.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts Dial setup

say_en.text: Register this Dial line with owner access, so only my paired phone reaches it.
Send the 6-digit pairing code I got to the Dial line to finish pairing.
say_en.note: Binds your phone to the line
